subject.title: feat: let agents remember across private conversations

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off per-agent `rememberAcrossConversations` config and plugin context API for same-agent private Active Memory recall after the branch is repaired?
rationale: The patch is a plausible implementation, but it creates durable product/config/plugin API and a privacy-sensitive transcript authorization path that automation cannot approve for maintainers.

options.title: Accept After Repair
options.body: Resolve conflicts, refresh generated docs, rerun exact-head proof, and merge after maintainer product/security review confirms the default-off same-agent private boundary.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Keep the behavior experimental or internal until the plugin API, docs, and upgrade expectations are explicitly settled.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Leave the canonical feature issue open and hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want this recall mode yet.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, refresh generated docs, rerun exact-head proof, and merge after maintainer product/security review confirms the default-off same-agent private boundary.
